question: Can bounded pair-crowding survival, or a parameter-free OR-combination of shallow potential and low surface density, preserve the galaxy improvement without extrapolation failure in the Solar System or deep porous clusters?

composite_candidates.meaning: The path is weakly screened if the system is either shallow or diffuse.
Smooth OR-like blend of shallow-potential and diffuse-surface survival.
A deep system can retain path strength when its 30 kpc pair crowding is low.

fit_and_validation.atomic_parameters: Fit only on P0623 development folds 0-3 with the same equal-galaxy objective.
fit_and_validation.composite_parameters: None beyond the already fitted atomic laws.
fit_and_validation.galaxy_test: Repeat four-fold development CV so composite components are trained inside each fold; report fold wins versus a fold-refit constant.
fit_and_validation.P0623_fold4: Already spent; descriptive replay only and not a promotion gate.
fit_and_validation.cluster_and_solar: No parameter refit of any kind.

transfer_rules.derived_pair: Use the same smooth-profile non-porous control as P0624.
transfer_rules.raw_pair: Use member-position pair crowding with 2 kpc member kernels as P0624.
transfer_rules.solar_pair: Use the compact one-solar-mass limit; bounded laws may not exceed their fitted ceiling.
transfer_rules.raw_geometry: Frozen P0554 geometry and profiled source positions.

decision_rules.bounded_pair_viable: At least 3/4 galaxy fold wins, all Solar proxies, no fewer raw roots than constant, and derived-cluster RMSE no worse than constant.
decision_rules.OR_viable: Must preserve at least half the potential-only galaxy CV improvement while meeting the same Solar/root/derived-cluster gates.
decision_rules.raw_RMS: Compare RMS only on common root-complete systems; topology is reported separately.
decision_rules.claim: No candidate is a theory until it has an independent sample and a covariant field derivation.

claim_limits: All samples are project-spent mechanism tests.
The OR operators are phenomenological logic for path survival, not covariant field equations.
Member luminosity is only a proxy for baryonic mass in the raw pair statistic.
Fixed-geometry raw scores do not replace full blind lens reconstruction.
